entries.label: CRISPR for high cholesterol
entries.quote: Over the past decade, the gene-editing tool CRISPR has rapidly evolved from the lab to the clinic.

entries.label: AI that makes images
entries.quote: Software models developed by Google, OpenAI, and others can now generate stunning artworks based on just a few text prompts.

entries.label: A chip design that changes everything
entries.quote: RISC-V is upending those power dynamics.

entries.label: Mass-market military drones
entries.quote: Advances in consumer componentry have helped drone manufacturers build complex war machines at much lower prices.

entries.label: Abortion pills via telemedicine
entries.quote: Healthcare providers and startups have turned to telehealth to prescribe and deliver pills for safe at-home abortions.

entries.label: Organs on demand
entries.quote: Scientists are genetically engineering pigs whose organs could be transplanted into humans and 3D-printing lungs using a patient's own cells.

entries.label: The inevitable EV
entries.quote: Batteries are getting cheaper and governments have passed stricter emissions rules or banned gas-powered vehicles altogether.

entries.label: James Webb Space Telescope
entries.quote: The first breathtaking images of the distant cosmos captured by the world's most powerful space telescope inspired collective awe.

entries.label: Ancient DNA analysis
entries.quote: Genomic sequencing tools now let us read very old strands of human DNA, revealing much about modern history.

entries.label: Battery recycling
entries.quote: Companies are building facilities that will reclaim lithium, nickel, and cobalt to feed metals back to battery manufacturers.

entries.label: Hydrogen planes
entries.quote: Using fuel cells to power zero-emission flights.
entries.note: Reader-voted 11th entry, added 2023-01-19. Not one of the editors' ten.

notes: Ten entries plus a reader-voted 11th (Hydrogen planes, added 2023-01-19). From 2022 on, each article page carries 'WHO' (key players) and 'WHEN' (availability) lines; the list page does not. Those lines were not read for this edition, so availability and key_players are null and status is partial. Quote is the list-page dek.
